snippet.title: Evum Gameplay Showcase - KR Version
snippet.description:
This video showcases Evum stopping, slowing, and rewinding time. This is a gameplay only footage that shows the action right away. Silent Gameplay Demo.

Videos of this channel is all about the upcoming indie game 'The Comyths'!
Character-driven action indie game that uses the forces of space, time, matter, life, mind, and void to bend the rules of combat!

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491050/The_Comyths/
